2.264.14
MapViewport.MapElementView
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapViewport.MapElementView element specifies the center of a MapViewport element based
on a map spatial element. The MapViewport.MapElementView element is optional and is of type
MapElementView.
Following is the parent element of the MapViewport.MapElementView element.
Parent elements
MapViewport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapViewport.MapElementView element.
 <xsd:element name="MapElementView" type="MapElementViewType" minOccurs="0" />
